remarks: This absolutely charming & artistic home has a unique layout with abundant entertaining spaces both indoor and out. As you walk into the foyer you are wowed by a large light-strewn sparkling white eat-in kitchen with breakfast bar and vaulted ceiling. The dining room with beautiful moulding and wall of windows is perfect for your holiday feast and has sliders to a wonderfully huge screened in porch ready for card games, family charades and outdoor events and if that is not enough it opens to a deck that runs most of the length of the house. The two bedrooms, used to be 3 are quite sizable and the living room has wonderful built in shelving and more windows. Below, a secret and special writers nook, art studio, office or family room awaits with an adjoining brick patio with room for tables and chairs. This home is nestled between Wilton and Ridgefield and just moments away from shopping yet completely secluded from all.
